scripts.copy: mkdir -p resources/public/fonts resources/public/js && cp -R node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts/. resources/public/fonts/ && cp -R assets/fonts/. resources/public/fonts/ && find resources/public/fonts -name '*.txt' -delete && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.min.js resources/public/js/bootstrap.min.js && perl -0pi -e 's{//# sourceMappingURL=\S+}{}' resources/public/js/bootstrap.min.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && npm run copy && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.debug: npm run clean && npm run copy && npm run build:css:debug && npm run build:js && npm run copy:debug
scripts.watch: vite build --watch & npm run build:css -- --watch & node watch-js.mjs
